**IdeaBlade Validation Editor 0.1.0**, the first full release of the desktop editor for [IdeaBlade Validation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation)'s validation metadata: JSON files, TypeScript `ModelValidationMetadataMap` objects and C# JSON strings, edited in forms instead of by hand, with the library's own checks as you type. It follows four alphas and now works with IdeaBlade Validation 0.1.1.

> **Note:** What you see here was written in a few hours with the help of [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). It's meant as a developer tool, not a fully fleshed-out production app.

## Downloads

| | Download | Installing |
|---|---|---|

It's not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: *More info* → *Run anyway*. It installs for everyone (Program Files, with an administrator prompt) or only for you, over an alpha if that's installed. |

It's not signed with an Apple certificate or notarized, so the first time, right-click the app → *Open* → *Open* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/IdeaBlade Validation Editor.app"`). |

| **Linux** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | `chmod +x` it and run it. |
| **Linux**, Debian or Ubuntu (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.0/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-linux-amd64.deb) | `sudo apt install ./IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.0-linux-amd64.deb` |

**Updating:** alpha.3 and alpha.4 on Windows or as an AppImage find this version by themselves (at start, every few hours, or Help → Check for Updates…), download it, and offer **Restart to update**. On macOS and with the .deb they say it's out and link here. Coming from alpha.1 or alpha.2, install it by hand once.

**Pre-releases are now off by default.** *Include pre-releases* in the sidebar's Settings was on in the alphas, since there was nothing else. From 0.1.0 it's off, so the editor only offers full releases; turn it on to get alphas, betas and release candidates too. If you changed an update setting in an alpha, the alpha saved both, so your Include pre-releases stays as it was: turn it off by hand if you like.

## What's in it

- **Metadata in JSON, TypeScript or C#**, several files side by side, checked together as the library merges them. TS and C# files are rewritten only where the metadata is; the pane on the right shows the file as saving will write it.
- **Forms for everything in the metadata**: model types, `extends`, conditions, model-level rules, properties, groups, `from`, and every built-in validator's settings, plus the application's own validators and expression functions, read from its TS and C# sources.
- **Sources**: Breeze metadata, TypeScript and C# files and folders with entities, view models and DTOs, so model types and properties are picked from lists, and typos and validators that don't fit a property are flagged.
- **Code completion in expressions**, a **regular expression panel** with values to try, a **JSON view** that's a code editor, and **Try it** to validate a sample object with the library itself.
- **Project files** (`*.ivproj`) to share the files, sources and settings with the team; recent projects; the last one reopens.
- **Automatic updates** on Windows and with the AppImage; on macOS and with the .deb, a link to the new release.

## What's changed since alpha.4

- **IdeaBlade Validation 0.1.1.** The `required` validator's new `allowEmptyString` setting (any string passes, `''` included; `null` still fails) has a checkbox next to `trim`, and the schema check knows both.
- **New warnings:** `trim` together with `allowEmptyString` (`trim` then has no effect), and either of them on a property that isn't text (the validator ignores them there).
- **Search a model's properties and rules.** *Find properties and rules…* above a model's properties narrows them to those whose name, display name, shorthands or rules have every word typed; *Find rules…* does the same for the model-level and global rules. Enter opens the first match, Esc clears.
- **Include pre-releases is off by default**, as above.
- Electron 45.5 and other dependency updates.

See the [README](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/blob/v0.1.0/README.md) for the details, [alpha.4's notes](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.4) for the changes before this, and the [library's documentation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation/tree/main/docs) for the metadata itself.
